recipe.visualDefinition: A minimalist graphic design showcasing a chunky, modern sans-serif typeface named 'Nekta' against a vibrant blue background. The design features prominent typography for the typeface name, smaller descriptive text, and a circular logo element, all arranged with clear visual hierarchy and ample negative space.
coreVisualRelationships: The large, bold 'Nekta' typeface dominates the lower half of the composition, contrasting with the smaller, more conventional text at the top.
The vibrant blue background provides a high-contrast canvas for the black and cream text and logo elements.
The circular 'Zarma Type' logo acts as a distinct, lighter accent against the dark 'Nekta' text.
The top-left text block establishes the brand and purpose, while the top-right text provides additional font details.
The bottom-right copyright information anchors the composition.
coreInvariants: The background must be a solid, vibrant blue (e.g., #22A7F0).
The primary typeface name ('Nekta') must be rendered in a large, chunky, black sans-serif font.
Descriptive text and brand name must be in black, sans-serif, and significantly smaller than the main typeface name.
The 'Zarma Type' logo must be a cream-colored (e.g., #FBF4D8) oval or circular shape with black text inside, positioned near the main typeface name.
The overall layout must maintain significant negative space, especially in the upper and central areas.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The main subject, the 'Nekta' typeface, occupies approximately 60-70% of the lower half of the canvas, positioned centrally. Supporting text is smaller and placed in the top-left and top-right corners, with the logo element positioned above and slightly to the right of the main typeface.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bold 'Nekta' text serves as the primary visual anchor due to its size, weight, and central-lower placement.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye is initially drawn to the large 'Nekta' text, then moves upwards to the 'Zarma Type' logo, and subsequently to the descriptive text in the top-left, concluding with the smaller details in the top-right and bottom-right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Abundant negative space, particularly in the upper two-thirds of the image, emphasizes the typography and creates a clean, modern aesthetic. The blue background itself functions as the primary negative space.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: The vibrant blue (#22A7F0) serves as the dominant background color, providing a clean and energetic foundation.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black (#000000) is the primary contrast color, used for all main text elements, ensuring high readability against the blue.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cream (#FBF4D8) acts as the accent color, used for the 'Zarma Type' logo background, providing a subtle highlight and breaking the blue/black dichotomy.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: The dominant blue is highly saturated and medium value. Black provides maximum value contrast. Cream offers a lighter value and lower saturation accent.
paletteRestrictions: Strictly limited to vibrant blue, black, and cream.
Colors must be solid and flat.

adjustableVariables: The specific chunky sans-serif typeface used for 'Nekta'.
The exact wording of the descriptive text and brand name.
The year in the copyright notice.
The specific shape and internal text of the 'Zarma Type' logo (while maintaining cream background and black text).
Minor adjustments to text positioning for optimal balance.
mustRedesign: The 'Nekta' typeface itself, if a different chunky sans-serif is desired.
The 'Zarma Type' logo design, if a different brand identity is required.

mustAchieve: Clear legibility of all text elements.
Strong visual contrast between text and background.
A sense of spaciousness and uncluttered design.
The typeface being showcased must appear bold and impactful.
avoid: Serif fonts for the main typeface name.
Any imagery or graphics beyond the typography and simple logo.

postGenerationChecks: Is the main typeface name 'Nekta' clearly the largest and most prominent element?
Is the background a solid, vibrant blue?
Are all text elements either black or cream (for the logo background)?
Is there ample negative space, particularly in the upper half?
Does the overall design convey a modern and bold impression?
Is the 'Zarma Type' logo distinct and easily identifiable?
recipe.reuseFormula: Adopt a vibrant, solid blue background. Place a large, chunky, black sans-serif typeface name centrally in the lower half. Position smaller, black sans-serif descriptive text in the top-left. Include a cream-colored oval/circular logo with black text near the main typeface name. Add a small, black copyright notice in the bottom-right. Maintain significant negative space throughout.

typesetting.case: title case with all caps emphasis

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: contrast in weight and style (chunky sans-serif with geometric sans-serif and a subtle serif)
graphicDevices: oval shape with thick outline around logo-like text
short horizontal line as a separator

preserve: contrast between display and supporting text
use of all caps for emphasis
avoid: thin or light weight display typefaces

candidateDirections.reason: To maintain the playful, bold, and modern aesthetic of the primary display text. Look for high x-height, rounded terminals, and heavy weight.
To provide a clean, modern, and legible contrast for the smaller text elements, maintaining a contemporary feel.
As an alternative to geometric sans-serif for supporting text, offering slightly more warmth and readability while still being modern.
To replace the small serif used for metadata, offering a bolder, more distinct character that still contrasts with the sans-serifs.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a solid, vibrant blue background. Place a small, thin white horizontal line near the top-left. Place a small, off-white oval shape with a thick white outline near the top-right, partially overlapping the area where the large display text will be.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Overlay the large, chunky, rounded sans-serif display text in black at the bottom-center. Overlay the geometric sans-serif subtitle text in white, all caps, at the top-left. Overlay the geometric sans-serif body text in white, with 'BOLD YOUR BRAND' in all caps, below the subtitle. Overlay the geometric sans-serif logo-like text in black, all caps, inside the off-white oval. Overlay the small serif metadata text in white, title case, at the top-right. Overlay the small geometric sans-serif caption text in white, title case, at the bottom-right.

verificationChecks: Is the display text significantly larger and heavier than all other text?
Are the supporting sans-serifs clean and geometric in appearance?
Is there a clear hierarchy of information established by font size and weight?
Is the overall color scheme (blue, black, white, off-white) maintained?
